arguments.cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
import glob, shutil, trimesh
for f in sorted(glob.glob('checks/assembly/model.assembly.*.stl')):
    m = trimesh.load(f)
    print(f, 'vol', round(float(m.volume)), 'bounds', m.bounds.tolist())
    # base: rests on z=0 and is the larger volume; lid: lowest z ~16.3
    dst = 'checks/final_base.stl' if m.bounds[0][2] < 1 else 'checks/final_lid.stl'
    shutil.copy(f, dst)
    print(' ->', dst)
PY
ls -l checks/final_*.stl
